description: This file defines the ChatList React functional component which displays a list of chat items, including search functionality, within a sidebar of a WhatsApp Web clone UI. It manages search state, filters chat data based on user input, and renders chat list items along with header controls.

methods.name: ChatList({ chats, activeChat, onChatSelect })
methods.description: React functional component that renders a searchable list of chats, highlighting the active chat, and providing controls for creating new chats and accessing menu options.
